# Wrestling
Wrestling is a [textlink="martial art" link="MartialArts"] that turns any hallway into a ring. Slams, throws and flying leaps put opponents on the floor fast, and the most crowd-riling moves happen when your opponent is already there. Nobody learns this from a manual. You pick it up the moment you strap on a championship belt, and you forget all of it the moment the belt comes off.
## Championship Belts
### Championship Belt
Proof that you are the greatest in the Nanotrasen Wrestling Federation, and can be found on most stations. Its moves only count in a title match, so your opponent has to be wearing a championship belt too. This is professional wrestling, after all.
### Intercontinental Champion Belt
A world-class title belt the Syndicate can provide to you. It works on anyone, belt or not. It also toughens up whoever wears it, softening incoming Blunt hits and Stamina damage, and it comes with a no-disqualification special: the steel chair.
## Special abilities
### Steel Chair
The Intercontinental Champion title holder can pull their trusty steel folding chair into a free hand whenever they feel the need to go No Holds Barred. If it gets broken, a brand new chair can be found "under the ring" and you'll make your point known by shouting [bold]NO DISQUALIFICATIONS![/bold] for everyone to hear. It hits harder than a regular chair, knocks people down when thrown and has a chance to deflect projectiles.
## Combo attacks
Some of the flashier moves knock you down for a moment too since you're throwing your whole body into them.
### Suplex
Hoists the opponent up and tosses them over your shoulder, dealing Blunt and Stamina damage and knocking them down. Only works on standing opponents.
### RKO
Outta nowhere! Leaps at the opponent and drives their head into the floor, dealing Blunt damage to the head and knocking them down. You land on the floor right next to them. Needs a running start, so you have to be moving when you finish the combo. Only works on standing opponents.
### DDT
Spikes a standing opponent head-first into the floor, dealing Blunt damage to the head and some Stamina damage, and knocks you both down. When done to an opponent who's already down it becomes a weaker hit to the head that makes them drop whatever they're holding.
### Dropkick
Both feet, right to the chest. Deals Blunt damage and a lot of Stamina damage, sending the opponent back and knocking them down. You hit the floor too. Only works on standing opponents.
### Elbow Drop
Throws yourself elbow-first onto a downed opponent, dealing Blunt damage to the chest and keeping them stunned. Only works on downed opponents.
### Submission Hold
Locks a downed opponent into a choke hold, dealing some Stamina damage and pinning them to the floor. Opponents with stamina resistance wriggle free sooner. Only works on downed opponents.
### Powerbomb
The finisher. Only works on an opponent you already have in a Submission Hold. Lifts them up and slams them into the floor for heavy Blunt and Stamina damage, causing your opponent to stay floored for a while. The bell rings, the crowd cheers, and you can't help but shout your catchphrase. If the Powerbomb puts them into critical condition, it's guaranteed to make the crowd go wild.
